mapper.insert: INSERT INTO release_sql_log (plan_id, step_id, step_no, run_seq, operator, file_name, seq, sql_preview, status, duration_ms, error_msg, executed_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{stepId}, #{stepNo}, #{runSeq}, #{operator}, #{fileName}, #{seq}, #{sqlPreview}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT step_no AS "stepNo", count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAIL') AS "failCount" FROM release_sql_log WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND run_seq = (SELECT max(run_seq) FROM release_sql_log WHERE plan_id = #{planId}) GROUP BY step_no ORDER BY step_no
